dict.string:
on run argv if (count of argv) is 0 then return
set folderPath to item 1 of argv set configFile to "/Users/csaborio/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Personal/Application Settings/Alfred/Alfred.alfredpreferences/workflows/user.workflow.B5A1A856-928B-4CC0-AC6D-932FC355D213/fav_folders.txt" set promptResult to display dialog "Nickname for this folder:" default answer "" buttons {"Cancel", "Save"} default button "Save" cancel button "Cancel" set nickname to text returned of promptResult
if nickname is "" then return
do shell script "/usr/bin/printf '%s %s\\n' " & quoted form of nickname & " " & quoted form of folderPath & " >> " & quoted form of configFile display notification "Added " & nickname & " to Favourite Folders" with title "Favourite Folders" end run
